department: Graduate Program in Data Science (Applied Mathematics and Statistics with Computer Science)

deadline.value: The Graduate School portal lists January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027 PhD applicants. The department page still shows the Fall 2026 cycle (December 15, 2025 for funding consideration).
deadline.quote: Data Science PhD Doctorate Fall 2027 1278 January 15, 2027 January 15, 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applications are submitted online and reviewed by the admissions committee; no supervisor agreement is required prior to admission.
supervisor.quote: Applications without transcript scans will not be reviewed by the admissions committee.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are automatically considered for financial support and tuition waiver if they apply by the funding deadline; not stated as guaranteed.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the PhD program will automatically be considered for financial support and tuition waiver if the application is submitted by the due date.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics or a related field is the stated requirement; MS students can also transfer into the PhD.
entry_route.quote: A. A bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, a natural science, engineering, an applied science, or social science with a strong mathematics and programming background.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is not required, though applicants are welcome to submit scores.
gre_general.quote: the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test is NOT required. However, you are most welcome to submit your GRE score should you have it.

notes: Jointly offered by AMS and Computer Science. The department page is written for the Fall 2026 cycle and its GRE statement refers to Fall 2025 applications, so GRE is left to the university record.
